result.instructions: strata long-term memory: `remember` facts, `recall` them later by question; tags filter by user/session.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall the memories most relevant to a question (BM25 over the memory texts). Optionally only memories whose tag `tag_key` equals `tag_value`.

k.description: How many memories to return (default 5, max 100).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store one memory (a fact, note or message) so it can be recalled later. Optional tags (e.g. user, session) can be used to filter recall.

id.description: Optional stable id (an existing memory with this id is replaced).

tags.description:
Optional tags, e.g. {"user": "alice", "session": "12"}; usable as
filters in `recall` and `search`.

tools.name: remember_many
tools.description: Store many memories in one durable write.

id.description: Optional stable id (an existing memory with this id is replaced).

tags.description:
Optional tags, e.g. {"user": "alice", "session": "12"}; usable as
filters in `recall` and `search`.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search memories with the strata query language: words, +must, -mustnot, "exact phrase", prefix*, tag:value, tag:[lo TO hi].

query.description: strata query language: words, +must, -not, "phrases", prefix*, tag:value.
